annotations.title: NFL Usage: Target, Carry & Red-Zone Shares

description: Use this when the user asks about NFL usage: who gets the most targets or carries, target and carry shares, opportunity share, red-zone looks, or how a team's shares change without a teammate. Returns, by `view`: "league" (every player's season and recent shares, biggest roles first), "red_zone" (targets and carries from the opponent's 20 in), "team" (a team_id: its players' shares, the regulars who missed games and, with `without_player_id`, each player's shares with and without him). Without Keel Stats Pro the league view lists the five biggest roles, the red zone its season alone, and the team view is refused; `account.held` says so. Not for NBA usage: use stat_forecasts or rankings_and_ratings.

season.description: Optional season year. Defaults to the season in play.

team_id.description: Numeric NFL team ID from search, for the team view.

without_player_id.description: Optional, the team view: each player's shares with and without this teammate.
